N1.referenceKind: two-node lumped (rigid conduit column between two lumped storages: tank + half the conduit surface each)

oscillatingModesCarryNoLinearVolume.note: sum_i S_i phi_mi = 0 for every oscillating mode of the reference network

periodTolerance.status: a declared TOLERANCE for the W3 diagnostic and the comparability rule; not an a-priori uncertainty bound; no scored bound uses it

level.kind: computed: lumped model re-solved at h_eq +- 2 mm

amplitude.kind: scaling estimate: O(a / y_hyd), coefficient 1 not derived

timeDiscretisationFundamental.kind: UNBOUNDED ESTIMATE: (w dt)^2/12 of a generic one-step scheme; SWMM EXTRAN (Picard iteration with under-relaxation 0.5, trapezoidal node continuity, backward-Euler link momentum) is not analysed

periodTolerance.combination: linear sum of the four values, rounded up to the next 0.5 %

window.why: M reference periods put the window ends nearly in phase, which keeps the computed inertial term small; no validity condition depends on the period

budgets.note: worst case: window ends at opposite phase, friction and convection at their amplitude maxima; at run time the terms are computed from the record and are smaller for a decaying oscillation averaged over whole periods

draft2C2Superseded.why: assumed that the internal deviation from the linear surface is at most a; not proved (technical review of draft 2, item 2); no longer used

secondOrder.definitionSensitivity: C_fn = (1/12) max|dW/dy| sum_s L_s (y_i - y_i+1)^2: bounds the difference between the linear-surface volume (the reference) and the trapezoidal (1/12) or midpoint (1/24) volume of the same node depths
secondOrder.levelRemainder: R2 = 0.5 max|dW/dy| sum_s L_s max(u_i^2, u_i+1^2), u_i = y_i - tank-mean level: Taylor remainder of the representation volume about the level state
